note: The problem was not explicitly posed as a conjecture but emerged implicitly from Kari's 1996 result proving that one- and two-dimensional reversible cellular automata can be decomposed into locally reversible components. The natural question for higher dimensions (3+) follows from this theorem. Durand-Lose (2001) later reinforced the question but did not originate it.
